title: The Unidirectional Current as First Arrival-Time POVM: An MS-Kijowski Identity, Physical Interpretation, and Mathematical Applications
summary: Detector-based first-arrival models and operator-based arrival-time observables provide two conceptually distinct approaches to the quantum time-of-arrival problem. Here we connect these approaches by using the positive unidirectional first-arrival current of Marchewka and Schuss (MS) as the basis for constructing a family of positive arrival-time operators and, after normalization, an arrival-time POVM.
